unregistered.heading: Welcome
unregistered.body: Vulna is used to photograph wounds and scan documents at the bedside. The device registers with the hospital first.

approved.body: Sign in with your hospital account. The hospital opens its secure sign-in window.

revoked.body: An administrator revoked this device and the app data on it was deleted. Contact the IT department.

blocked.body: A change to the operating system was found. The device will not be registered. Ask the application administrator.

unreachable.heading: No connection
unreachable.body: Check the connection to the hospital network or its VPN. Then try again.
unreachable.note: If the trouble lasts, ask your IT administrator.

itInformation.body: These details help the IT administrator sort out access to the app.

bodyWithUnsent.other: A change to the operating system was found. The data of the app including {n} unsent records was deleted.

advice.body: Ask the application administrator. After a review they unblock the device and you register the app again. The administrator has to approve the new registration even on a device managed through MDM.

advice.heading: The hospital server could not be told yet
advice.body: Tell the application administrator which device this is. After a review they unblock the device and you register the app again.

awaiting.delivery: the report leaves once there is a connection

permissions.heading: Permissions
permissions.body: To photograph wounds, scan documents and sign in with a card, the app needs the camera and NFC. The device asks for both now.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: To photograph wounds and scan documents at the bedside.

nfc.title: NFC
nfc.body: To sign in with a staff card and read the patient tag.
